E01-Hadoop Configuration.pdf PDF

I've uploaded my Hadoop configuration file. Can you review it for common mistakes?

I can see your hadoop-env.sh configuration. I notice that JAVA_HOME is not explicitly set in this file — it's commented out. This is a common cause of the "JAVA_HOME is not set" error when running start-dfs.sh, because the start scripts source hadoop-env.sh directly rather than inheriting from your shell environment.

To fix this, uncomment the JAVA_HOME line and set it to the correct path for your Java installation.

E00-Big Data Lab Setup.pdf PDF

Here's the lab setup document too. Does it have the correct Java version requirements?

Based on the lab setup document, the course requires Java 8 or Java 11. Both are compatible with Hadoop 3.x. If you have Java 17 or later, you may encounter module access issues with some Hadoop versions — I'd recommend sticking with Java 11 LTS for the best compatibility.
